layout_and_spacing.architecture: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation) mixed with Social Feed.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align text, right-align metrics and numbers. Center-align empty state graphics.

components.cards: Flat design. 1px border-zinc-200. No shadows. Max border-radius: rounded-md.
components.buttons: Clear distinct states. Primary: dark solid. Secondary: transparent with 1px outline.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar, crystal glass effect: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-zinc-200.
components.badges: Subtle rounded styling. Used extensively for party affiliation, status, and role.
components.tables: Dense. Row hover effect (hover:bg-zinc-50). Used for promises and voting records.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on hover. Cards: -translate-y-0.5, border darkening.

politician_profiles.description: Professional headshots for politician profile photos.

government_buildings.description: Hero backgrounds or placeholder headers for constituency pages.

data_abstract.description: Abstract visual representation for data and network connectivity.

accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a hybrid platform combining civic tracking dashboard and social network.
Strictly follow Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast. Prioritize clear data and authority.
Implement tabular numerals for all metrics, dates, and tracker numbers.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL actionable items (buttons, inputs, filters).
Never use generic placeholder images (dummyimage/via.placeholder), use media URLs from this file.
Maintain high contrast. Rely on 1px borders and structural grayscale to delineate sections.
Since .js files are used, ensure guidelines and code assume .js, not .tsx extensions.
